_what: How sign-ups, payments and other outcomes are sent back to the ad platform a visitor came from (do-work/prepare-ad-conversions.mjs). Each shape is one platform's conversion upload: tool_id is the connection tool that sends it (parts/service-connections records.json), account the destination fields copied into that tool's input (account_optional when given), events_field the input field that holds the events, most_per_send how many events one send may carry, oldest_days how old an event the platform still takes, send_per_outcome_target the tool input field that names the outcome's target when each outcome goes in its own send (else the target is the event fact outcome_target), email_steps and phone_steps how the platform says an email address or phone number is made plain before its SHA-256 is taken (the platform's own rule), needs_any the facts of which an event must carry at least one to be matched, and event the event, where { "from": "fact" } is one fact of the conversion and is left out when the conversion has none (an object or list left empty is left out too). The facts are event_id, at_seconds, at_iso, value, currency, outcome, outcome_target, email_sha256, phone_sha256 and click.<click id> from the visitor's first touch. plain_mail_domains are the domains whose local part the gmail-local step makes plain.
